name: handlist
description: A strict, human-friendly subset of YAML for hand-edited configuration files

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && tsc -p tsconfig.types.json && node scripts/postbuild.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test dist/test/test/*.test.js
